title: Freya and the Verdict
author: Ines Galloway
blurb: Lena Nakamura, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
